dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Do you now understand where you went wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Kagemni
dialogues.text: I... I shouldn't have trusted in rumors...

dialogues.speaker: Kagemni
dialogues.text: And, uh... I... I shouldn't have gone babbling to your grandson about that hearsay?

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: Well, that was wrong of you, yes, but is that really the most important thing?

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: What's the point of just "knowing" things? Do them! That's the important part!

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: It's because you're always lounging around at home that you wound up believing those baseless rumors!

dialogues.speaker: Kulsoom
dialogues.text: You're still young — you've still got all the time in the world to learn new things. Why don't you follow Setaria's example and go study?

dialogues.speaker: Kagemni
dialogues.text: What are you staring at, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Kagemni
dialogues.text: Just look at you! Could it be that you're a lapdog of the Dendro Archon?

dialogues.speaker: Kagemni
dialogues.text: As desert-dwellers, it is our duty to retain our faith in King Deshret!

dialogues.speaker: Kagemni
dialogues.text: He will return to us, and when that day comes, he will return the faithful to our former prosperity and glory!

dialogues.speaker: Kagemni
dialogues.text: As for those of you who betrayed King Deshret... You'll pay for all that you've done!
